Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 18

“Such a one has no purpose at all in what is done or not done here, nor any dependence upon any being for any purpose whatever.”

The exemption spelled out. Note the second half — not merely freedom from tasks but freedom from needing anything from anyone, which is what makes the first half possible.
